final: WITH joined AS (SELECT s.arcref AS arcref, p.fundflux AS fundflux, s.boxx * 1.0 / s.boxz AS ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry), proj_groups AS (SELECT arcref, fundflux, AVG(ratio) AS proj_avg FROM joined GROUP BY arcref, fundflux), fund_groups AS (SELECT fundflux, AVG(proj_avg) AS fund_avg FROM proj_groups GROUP BY fundflux) SELECT pg.arcref, pg.fundflux, pg.proj_avg, pg.proj_avg - fg.fund_avg AS diff FROM proj_groups pg JOIN fund_groups fg ON pg.fundflux = fg.fundflux WHERE pg.proj_avg > fg.fund_avg ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
